titre: Synthesis test n°3 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Read and answer.

Hi! I am Sam. I have a dog. It is big and brown. I like apples and bread. I do not like fish.

1) What is his name? .......... (1,5)
2) What pet does he have? .......... (1,5)
3) What food does he like? .......... (1,5)
4) What food does he not like? .......... (1,5)

Animals.
1) Circle the animals: (3 points)
dog — apple — bird — cat — bread.
2) Complete: (2 points)
A bird can f .... y.   A fish can s .... .... m.

Food.
1) Circle the food words: (3 points)
apple — cat — bread — dog — milk.
2) Complete: (2 points)
I like .......... .   I do not like .......... .

About you. Complete. (4 points)
My favourite animal is a .......... .
My favourite food is .......... .

Grammar: This is / These are.
Complete with This is or These are.
1) .......... a dog. (one dog)
2) .......... apples. (many apples)
3) .......... my cat. (one cat)
4) .......... birds. (many birds)
